FORENSICS CORRECTION (full 9-traj read + verifier contract): configure-git-webserver fails are an INSTRUCTION-VERIFIER CONTRACT MISMATCH, not verify-then-mutate. The verifier clones git@localhost and answers the password prompt with the literal string password; the instruction says clone user@server and "I will setup login, you do not have to worry about that". All 9 failing trials obeyed the instruction (own identities, key auth, two even locked passwords); none created a git user with password auth. No bullet wording fixes this — passing requires ignoring the instruction and guessing the git-server convention. Task-defect family (like prove-plus-comm WORKDIR). Verify-then-mutate was present but non-causal for most trials (verifier pushes fresh); one trial added real damage via reset surgery. The earlier verify-then-mutate-as-primary claim is retracted; the ordering-explicit wording idea remains plausible for GENUINE stale-state divergence but this probe does not evidence it.
